plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Control k-Coder's separate, policy-governed browser session with the built-in browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, browser_click, browser_type, browser_screenshot, and browser_close tools. The controlled session is distinct from the workbench preview iframe.

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: Create and edit document artifacts in k-Coder, including Word files and Google Docs.

plugins.name: presentations
plugins.description: Create, edit, render, verify, and export presentation slide decks. Use when Codex needs to build or modify a deck, slidedeck, presentation deck, slide deck, slides, PowerPoint, Google Slides, PPT, PPTX, .ppt, or .pptx file.

plugins.name: record-replay
plugins.description: Record local browser action structure with parameterized inputs and URLs, compile workflows to k-Coder's browser_* contract, and replay them in system Edge with bounded reports.

plugins.name: sites
plugins.description: Build, test and preview local websites in k-Coder. Prepare deployment artifacts; the original OpenAI Sites cloud connector remains unavailable.
